summary.text: HCSA has no extra-territorial powers. Care received overseas is outside its jurisdiction.

details.heading: HCSA has no overseas powers
details.body: HCSA does not have extra-territorial powers, so it cannot take an overseas healthcare service provider to task under HCSA.

details.heading: Care received overseas
details.body: Healthcare services provided to local patients who travel overseas are outside HCSA's jurisdiction.

example_phrasings: Will the HCSA be able to take an errant healthcare service provider located overseas treating a local patient to task?
Can HCSA act against an overseas provider?
Will HCSA take an overseas provider to task?

sources.page_title: Will the HCSA be able to take an errant healthcare service provider located overseas treating a local patient to task?

quotes.text: HCSA does not have extra-territorial powers.
The provision of healthcare services to local patients who travel overseas is also outside the jurisdiction of HCSA.
